name: Conspiration: Le défi des derniers rois
summary: Conspiration: Le défi des derniers rois is a French-language Adventure game, developed and published by Ubisoft, which was released in Europe in 1988. You must go back in time, in order to prevent a conspiracy. This is a text adventure game with accompanying graphics.
